name: guard
about: HWP::Guard (hwplib Guard.as) around a module whose UpdateFrame throws every frame from frame 300 (gamelab-guard, wrapped as tools/guard_modules.py wraps every HWP module): the guard logs the failure, lets one call through so the engine logs the stack trace (once per game process: on the next level the guard catches every failure), turns the entry point off after 30 in a row with one chat line, and the game mode's update after the module loop keeps running (a screen shake entry ages; unguarded it does not: throw 20261027-030133). Then hwp guard lists it.

steps.name: the trace run: the engine logs where

steps.pattern: \[HWP:guard\] GameLabGuardModule\.UpdateFrame turned off until the next level after 30 script exception\(s\), 30 in a row
steps.name: turned off after 30 in a row

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] The gamelab-guard mod hit a script error
steps.name: the chat line, from the lang string
the update after the module loop runs while it fails
and after it is turned off
the body stopped running at the trip

steps.pattern: \[HWP:core\] module created, version [\d.]+, game build 176 \(tested on 176\)
steps.name: the game build, as the pin names it

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] Heroes of Hammerwatch II is on build 176; this HammerwatchPlus was tested on build 175
steps.name: a build it was not tested on: the chat line

steps.pattern: Heroes of Hammerwatch II is on build
steps.name: once per build

steps.pattern: \[HWP:guard\] GameLabGuardModule\.UpdateFrame turned off until the next level after 30 script exception\(s\), 30 in a row
steps.name: the next level: turned off again
and no second trace run in the same game process
